kamloops.title: Status of ‘iconic’ mountain goats living near evacuated B.C. community is uncertain
kamloops.description: It is not clear yet what has happened to a small group of "iconic"  mountain goats, as a large wildfire burns out of control near the evacuated community of Summerland, B.C.

kamloops.title: Chief calls for co-operation to prevent fires as world changes at a ‘rapid pace’
kamloops.description: Chief Greg Gabriel, whose members are among the evacuees, says that could mean looking at logging practices and addressing drought conditions.

kamloops.title: Summerland wildfire livestock ‘hero’ stopped after breaking the rules
kamloops.description: Animal rescuer Kazimir Nowlin has been working since Friday to get animals and livestock to safety and away from the danger of the massive Bald Range fire.

kamloops.title: B.C. Premier David Eby says visit to Interior ravaged by wildfires was ‘moving’
kamloops.description: Kelly Greene, Minister of Emergency Management and Climate Readiness and Amelia Boultbee, MLA for Penticton-Summerland, will also be in attendance.

kamloops.title: Members of Okanagan Indian Band mourn loss of forests and irreplaceable artifacts in wildfire
kamloops.description: More than just homes have been destroyed by the Bradley Creek Wildfire. The Okanagan Indian Band Indigenous community has also lost irreplaceable artifacts and forests where their great-grandparents picked berries.

kamloops.title: B.C. premier promises review of emergency response to wildfire near Summerland, B.C.
What you need to know about B.C. wildfires on Aug. 12
kamloops.description: B.C. Premier David Eby has  promised to review  the province's emergency response in the wake of the Bald Range wildfire near Summerland, and says he hasn't ruled out calling for military assistance.

kamloops.title: Summerland wildfire evacuees turn to social media for damage details amid lack of official info
kamloops.description: Some wildfire evacuees from Summerland, B.C., say they are seeking out alternative sources of information about the fate of their community to fill an official void, even as authorities warn against the risk of misinformation.

prince-george.title: Fort St. James ER hours cut until at least October amid doctor shortage
prince-george.description: Northern Health is reducing emergency department hours at Nats’oojeh Hospital in Fort St. James because of a shortage of physicians, with the changes expected to continue until at least October.

prince-george.title: Why this American doctor is leaving Utah to serve a remote community in B.C.
prince-george.description: One American doctor said changes in B.C.'s health care have allowed him to move to Canada.

cariboo.title: B.C. Conservative Party worried Quesnel pulp mill curtailment could be permanent
cariboo.description:
The B.C. Conservative party says they're worried job losses could be permanent with a temporary curtailment of operations announced at the Quesnel River Pulp mill, owned by Millar Western Forest Products Ltd. 
In a press release, the party said 90 workers will be affected by the curtailment, with operations expected to halt by September and resume in November.

southeast.title: Fernie starts construction on purpose-built fire hall
southeast.description: Fernie’s new fire hall is now under construction after years of debate over its Prentice Park location.

southeast.title: Cranbrook wants a hospice house, but where it should go is up for debate
southeast.description: Cranbrook residents will be surveyed this fall on five possible locations for a proposed 10-bed hospice house, including the Mount Baker RV Campground.

all.title: Calgary Flames coming home to QR Calgary 770 AM radio
all.description: The Calgary Flames have a new radio broadcaster, following the signing of a five-year partnership for all home and away games to be aired on QR Calgary 770 AM.

all.title: What you need to know about B.C. wildfires on Aug. 13
all.description: B.C.'s premier has promised to review the province's emergency response in the wake of the Bald Range wildfire, which remains out of control near Summerland and is among more than 100 fires burning throughout B.C.

all.title: Tending the animals trapped by B.C. wildfires: 'You can see their whole spirit change'
all.description: On Tuesday, Agriculture Minister Lana Popham said up to 50,000 agricultural animals were under threat from wildfires.
